notes: UC-010 WI-02 — Geo schema + migration. Migration name: 20260914211641_AddMapyGeoSchema. Migration is additive-only: 2 nullable ADD COLUMNs on orders (distance_m, duration_s — no index per spec), 6 ADD COLUMNs on fleet_settings (4 with HasDefaultValue backfill: MapCenterLat=50.08, MapCenterLng=14.42, MapZoom=12, GeoMonthlyCreditBudget=250000; 2 nullable text with no default: MapyServerKey, MapyBrowserKey), plus CREATE TABLE geo_cache + geo_usage with composite PKs and one index (ix_geo_cache_created_at for TTL sweeps). GeoCacheKind enum is reused for both GeoCacheEntry.Kind and GeoUsage.Kind (deliberate — single enum covers all call kinds in both tables). GeoUsage also gets a cascade FK to Fleet (consistent with GeoCacheEntry). Neither entity is ITenantEntity and neither gets a global query filter — mirrors the RefreshToken/SmsCode no-filter pattern. FleetSettings.MapyServerKey must NEVER be logged or returned to the browser (security comment in FleetSettingsConfiguration).
